name: content-accessibility-utility-on-aws
description: A comprehensive solution for converting PDF documents to accessible HTML and remediating accessibility issues in web content

paragraphs: Digital content stakeholders across industries aim to streamline how they meet accessibility compliance standards efficiently. The Content Accessibility Utility on AWS offers a comprehensive solution for modernizing web content accessibility with state-of-the-art generative AI models, powered by Amazon Bedrock. It automatically audits and remediates WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 accessibility compliance issues, and offers a Python CLI, a Python API, and a deployable event-driven pipeline. Capabilities include batch processing for large volumes of content, usage tracking for cost management, and will…
features: Convert PDF documents to accessible HTML, preserving layout and visual appearance
